applicationPool.reason: the strongest entry in the pool. A real CotEditor.xcodeproj AppKit and SwiftUI document application with MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 14.0 and no LSUIElement, so it has an inspectable main window. It ships Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig with CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = - , an empty DEVELOPMENT_TEAM and a matching CotEditor-AdHoc.entitlements limited to the sandbox, user-selected files and printing, so a local build needs no Developer ID. Offline, operates on local files, and already ships a UI Tests target
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: closed issues carrying the bug label; seven were shortlisted as accessibility-observable and five verified

applicationPool.reason: a real Vienna.xcodeproj Objective-C AppKit application with a storyboard-driven Preferences window, which is a rich accessibility surface. Containment: Codesigning.xcconfig sets CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = Apple Development, so a local build must override it to ad-hoc, and ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME is on with entitlements that request AppleEvents automation and Sparkle mach-lookup exceptions. The network must be blocked so the first-launch demo feed refresh and the Sparkle update check stay inert; the preference pane under test is entirely offline
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: merged pull requests with fix in the title; four shortlisted, one verified

applicationPool.reason: a real Maccy.xcodeproj SwiftUI application that already ships MaccyUITests, and its Settings window is a genuine inspectable window that needs no Accessibility grant to itself, since Accessibility is only used for auto-paste. Containment is substantial: Info.plist sets LSUIElement true so there is no persistent main window; the project pins DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = MN3X4648SC with automatic signing and hardened runtime, which a local build must override to ad-hoc; the app continuously reads the system pasteboard, which is shared user state; and it carries a Sparkle feed URL, so the network must be blocked
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: closed issues carrying the bug label; one verified

applicationPool.reason: a native SwiftUI CodeEdit.xcodeproj that already ships real XCUITest targets including ProjectNavigatorUITests and HideInterfaceTests, which is direct evidence that its interface is accessibility-addressable. Sandboxed with user-selected read-write only. Selection must stay away from its terminal and task features. No defect verified here yet

a real FSNotes.xcodeproj with segregated macOS and iOS targets and minimal entitlements, but rejected as a defect source: its history is grab-bag commits with no linked issues and mixed iOS and macOS changes in the same commit, so no clean affected and fixed pair can be isolated

selectedDefects.issueTitle: "New File/Folder" are disabled when the focus is on a document
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: git ls-tree lists CotEditor.xcodeproj, CotEditor/, Configurations/, Tests and UI Tests; project.pbxproj declares MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 14.0; the file the fix touches, CotEditor/Sources/Document Window/File Browser/FileBrowserViewController.swift, is a Swift NSViewController conforming to NSMenuItemValidation, which is AppKit

accessibilityReachability.trigger: AXPress on the file browser Add button, then traverse its AXMenu to the AXMenuItem children
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXEnabled on the New File and New Folder menu items: false at the affected revision, true at the fixed revision, with AXPress a no-op while disabled
accessibilityReachability.note: the fix sets item.target = self for the context menu and Add button menu items so responder chain validation stops disabling them; the added lines sit directly above the file's existing setAccessibilityElement(true) call

signing.evidence: Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig is present at the affected revision with CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = - , CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Manual and an empty DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, pointing at CotEditor-AdHoc.entitlements which requests only the sandbox, user-selected read-write files and printing

selectedDefects.whySuitable: it exercises all three macos-ax adapter primitives in one flow: accessibility tree traversal into a menu, an AXPress action, and an AXEnabled attribute read. No network, no TCC prompt, and the application keeps an ordinary inspectable window
remaining: build both revisions locally with the shipped ad-hoc signing configuration and record the exact command and result
dump the accessibility tree of the built application and confirm the Add button and its menu items appear with the expected roles
state the exact identity and authority for the observable, and minimize the trigger
run three affected reproductions and three fixed controls with a reset application container and reset evidence
record neighboring legal behavior: a menu item that is legitimately disabled must stay disabled on the fixed build

signing.evidence: Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig is present at the affected revision 529d38e2

selectedDefects.whySuitable: the cleanest possible state oracle for this adapter: an AXPress followed by a window close and reopen followed by an AXValue read, with the entire round trip staying inside the accessibility API and no pixel comparison anywhere
remaining: build both revisions with the shipped ad-hoc configuration
confirm the SwiftUI Toggle exposes AXCheckBox with a stable AXTitle in the built application, including under a non-Japanese locale
state identity and authority, and minimize the trigger

selectedDefects.issueTitle: Line and character counts not displayed in status bar for some documents
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: CotEditor.xcodeproj and Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig are present, and the only code file the fix touches is CotEditor/Sources/Scanners/EditorCounter.swift in the application target

accessibilityReachability.trigger: open a document, which requires no more than launching the application against a prepared file
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXValue of the status bar AXStaticText: empty at the affected revision, a populated line and character count at the fixed revision
accessibilityReachability.note: the fix is a single line, added.contains(.count) becoming !added.isDisjoint(with: .count), because OptionSet contains requires all members

remaining: confirm on a built affected binary that the status bar really is empty for the reported document shape, since the defect is conditional

selectedDefects.issueTitle: Maccy won't remember setting to save Files
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: git ls-tree lists Maccy.xcodeproj, Maccy/ and MaccyUITests/; Maccy/Info.plist declares CFBundlePackageType APPL and NSPrincipalClass NSApplication; the file the fix touches, Maccy/Settings/StorageSettingsPane.swift, is a SwiftUI View

accessibilityReachability.trigger: AXPress the Files AXCheckBox in Settings, Storage
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXValue on that checkbox flips back to 0 on the affected build and stays 1 on the fixed build
accessibilityReachability.note: the fix is a single word, isSubset(of:) becoming isSuperset(of:)

signing.evidence: the project pins DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = MN3X4648SC, CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = Apple Development, automatic signing and hardened runtime, so the build must override to CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= . Entitlements are sandbox, user-selected read-only and a Sparkle mach-lookup exception, none of which need a paid team

selectedDefects.whySuitable: a second, independent application exercising the same AXPress and AXValue path through a different persistence binding, which is what keeps the eventual field benchmark from resting on one codebase
selectedDefects.caveat: Maccy sets LSUIElement true, so there is no persistent main window and the campaign must open the Settings window explicitly. The application also continuously reads the system pasteboard, which is shared user state, so the campaign must run against a scratch login session or accept that read. Rank this below the CotEditor candidates

selectedDefects.pullRequestTitle: Fix enabled state of controls in Syncing preferences panel
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: git ls-tree lists Vienna.xcodeproj, Vienna/ and Vienna Tests; Vienna/Sources/Preferences window/SyncingPreferencesViewController.m is Objective-C AppKit with IBOutlet NSTextField, NSSecureTextField and NSButton, driven by Vienna/Resources/Interfaces/Base.lproj/Preferences.storyboard. The fix commit 7ae4808 is the merge of pull request 2054 and its first parent, the affected revision, is mainline immediately before the merge; the substantive commit inside the branch is 9b23c67f320b290bce71dd794d6c0c4f22f25c05

accessibilityReachability.trigger: open Preferences and select the Syncing pane with the sync checkbox off, which is the default; optionally AXPress the sync AXCheckBox and re-read the pane
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXEnabled across the sibling controls: the source AXPopUpButton is enabled at the affected revision and disabled at the fixed revision, while the sibling AXTextField controls are correctly disabled in both
accessibilityReachability.note: at the affected revision viewWillAppear disables the source, host, username and password controls when sync is off and then unconditionally re-enables the popup on its last line; the fix removes that line and binds enablement through Cocoa bindings

signing.evidence: Vienna/Codesigning.xcconfig sets CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = Apple Development, which must be overridden to ad-hoc, and ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME is on, but Vienna/Vienna.entitlements has no sandbox key and requests only AppleEvents automation, app-scope bookmarks and Sparkle mach-lookup exceptions, so no paid Developer ID is required

selectedDefects.whySuitable: this is the only verified candidate whose whole signal is an AXEnabled read across a set of sibling controls rather than a single element, so it exercises accessibility subtree traversal, and it does so on an Objective-C, storyboard and Cocoa bindings stack rather than SwiftUI, which widens what the adapter is proven against
selectedDefects.caveat: there is no linked issue for this fix, only the pull request, so issueUrl and issueTitle are null rather than invented
remaining: build both revisions with the signing identity overridden to ad-hoc
block the network so the first-launch demo feed refresh and the Sparkle check stay inert, and record that as containment
state identity and authority, and minimize the trigger
run three affected reproductions and three fixed controls with reset evidence, resetting the preferences domain between runs
record neighboring legal behavior: the sibling text fields must be disabled on both builds

reserveCandidates.issueTitle: Text Encoding disappeared from the Status Bar
reserveCandidates.reason: both revisions verified and the ad-hoc signing configuration is present. A two-line fix in the status bar, observable as an empty versus populated AXValue. Held in reserve because it is the same observable shape as the counts candidate

reserveCandidates.issueTitle: Filename on toolbar remains "Untitled" after creating new file with custom name from sidebar
reserveCandidates.reason: both revisions verified, but the fix targets NSWindow.subtitle and it is not confirmed without running whether the subtitle is exposed as the window AXTitle or as a separate title bar AXStaticText. Promote only after an accessibility tree dump of a built application

rejectedCandidates.reason: the issue and both revisions are real, but reading app/sources/BaseDataDocument.m at the affected revision shows showViewForRepresenter: touches rep.view before addRepresenter:, so inside HexFiend.app the placeholder string is written while the controller is nil and is immediately overwritten. The symptom manifests only in third-party embedders of the framework, so it is not drivable through this application's accessibility tree

blockers.detail: four of the five selected defects were pushed directly to the default branch with no pull request; the CotEditor and Maccy maintainers do not merge fixes through pull requests, so pullRequestUrl is null for those four and a fixCommitUrl carries the reference instead
the vienna-rss candidate has no linked issue at all, only a pull request, so it has no issueUrl or issueTitle

the five verified defects come from three applications but are concentrated three to one to one, with CotEditor supplying the majority. Native macOS applications that are simultaneously offline, free of interactive permission grants, buildable ad-hoc, and linked to a specific issue are genuinely scarce, so widening beyond CotEditor, Maccy and vienna-rss is the main remaining inventory work

no candidate was built or launched. The ad-hoc signing claims for Maccy and vienna-rss are inferred from project.pbxproj and xcconfig values rather than proven by a successful launch; CotEditor's is stronger because an ad-hoc configuration and matching entitlements ship in the repository, but it is still unproven
no accessibility tree dump exists for any built candidate, so every accessibilityReachability claim is inferred from source and from the AppKit or SwiftUI control types involved rather than observed
